product_one_liner.value: Multiplier acquires professional-services firms, particularly accounting and tax practices, and equips them with custom AI workflows to automate work and scale service delivery.
product_one_liner.notes: The company announcement describes acquiring professional-services firms, including tax and accounting practices, and deploying configurable in-house AI workflows to automate tasks and increase scalability. Source: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250618278113/en/Multiplier-Holdings-Launches-With-%2427.5-Million-in-Funding-to-Accelerate-the-AI-Journey-for-Professional-Services-Firms

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer contain no pricing link, and the /pricing URL did not provide a pricing page. Source: https://www.multiplierholdings.com/

named_customers.notes: Unknown. The homepage names portfolio companies and includes partner testimonials, but these do not establish independent customers. No qualifying customer page, customer case-study collection or company-specific review listing was found to justify either two names or an empty-list answer. Source inspected: https://www.multiplierholdings.com/

employee_band.notes: The profile reports 33 employees as of August 4, 2026, which falls in the 21-50 band. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/865840-51

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile explicitly identifies the headquarters city as Singapore. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/865840-51 | hq_country: The company profile identifies headquarters as Singapore, Singapore, consistent with Multiplier's own statement that Singapore is its main home. Sources: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/865840-51 and https://linkedin.com/company/multiplier-holdings

founded_year.notes: The company profile explicitly lists Founded: 2022. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/865840-51

eng_blog.notes: The Ideas index contains business, career and AI-strategy thought leadership, not two engineering-authored posts explaining product implementation. The two AI-themed articles are attributed to the CEO and Head of Corporate Development. Sources: https://www.multiplierholdings.com/ideas, https://www.multiplierholdings.com/articles/human-heart-ai-muscle and https://www.multiplierholdings.com/articles/cathedral-casino

public_docs.notes: No documentation, help-center or developer-portal link appears in the public homepage navigation or footer. This meets the specified negative condition. Source: https://www.multiplierholdings.com/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job board lists six openings: operations, four engineering/design roles and a sales/business-development associate. None has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science term in its title. Source: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/multiplier-holdings

model_provider.notes: Unknown after checking the technology page, blog, legal/privacy disclosures and available documentation links. The Terms refer only to unnamed third-party AI providers; the privacy policy and blog likewise use generic AI/model terminology. No named provider or public subprocessor list was found. Sources: https://www.multiplierholdings.com/terms, https://www.multiplierholdings.com/privacy-policy and https://www.multiplierholdings.com/articles/cathedral-casino

compliance_certs.notes: The readable public Terms page names none of the five requested compliance claims. The privacy policy mentions UK GDPR only in the context of approved international-transfer countries, not as a certification or compliance claim. Sources: https://www.multiplierholdings.com/terms and https://www.multiplierholdings.com/privacy-policy

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The announcement explicitly identifies the investment as Series B, consistent with the latest funding record. Source: https://onsideaccounting.com/news-and-insights/multiplier-announces-series-b-and-arrival-of-allen-shim-as-cfo-and-president | funding_date: The latest-round record dates the Series B to August 4, 2026; the portfolio firm's announcement appeared August 5. Both support the requested month, 2026-08. Source: https://onsideaccounting.com/news-and-insights/multiplier-announces-series-b-and-arrival-of-allen-shim-as-cfo-and-president | funding_amount_usd: The August 2026 announcement states a $35 million Series B investment, matching the latest-round profile record. This is the round amount, not cumulative funding. Source: https://onsideaccounting.com/news-and-insights/multiplier-announces-series-b-and-arrival-of-allen-shim-as-cfo-and-president

raised_18mo.notes: The dated August 2026 announcement establishes a $35 million Series B within the preceding 18 months. Source: https://onsideaccounting.com/news-and-insights/multiplier-announces-series-b-and-arrival-of-allen-shim-as-cfo-and-president

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: None of the six listed openings is titled SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account executive. The Sales & Business Development Associate title does not match the specified qualifying titles. Source: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/multiplier-holdings

launched_6mo.notes: The public launch announcement is dated June 18, 2025, before the six-month window. The readable newer Ideas articles and company posts concern strategy, hiring, partnerships and growth rather than a product or major-feature release. Sources: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250618278113/en/Multiplier-Holdings-Launches-With-%2427.5-Million-in-Funding-to-Accelerate-the-AI-Journey-for-Professional-Services-Firms, https://www.multiplierholdings.com/ideas and https://linkedin.com/company/multiplier-holdings

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The dated August 5, 2026 announcement reports Allen Shim's appointment as President and CFO, and the company release confirms he joined. This falls within the preceding 12 months. Sources: https://onsideaccounting.com/news-and-insights/multiplier-announces-series-b-and-arrival-of-allen-shim-as-cfo-and-president and https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260804445816/en/Multiplier-Raises-%2435-Million-Series-B-to-Build-a-New-Model-for-Professional-Services
